windowList.note: host to client between window-list-start and window-list-stop, when the list changed; rect is [left, top, width, height] in virtual-desktop pixels and already includes the visible windows the app owns (menus, dialogs); windows are in z-order, topmost first; a minimized window has its restored rectangle; icon is absent when none was read, monitor when the rectangle is on no monitor

focusFailed.note: host to client when a window-focus could not be done

icon.note: host to client, the answer to a window-icon request; png is base64 of a 32 px PNG; a client caches it by hash for the session

clientBehaviour.open: send window-list-start when the switcher opens, so lists arrive
clientBehaviour.enter: send media-control follow:false if follow was on, then window-focus with an id from a received list
clientBehaviour.crop: crop the decoded frame to rect minus the streamed monitor's origin, scale to fit, letterbox; map pointer positions back through the crop to monitor-relative absolute input
clientBehaviour.notOnStreamedMonitor: show the full desktop with a notice until the app's monitor is the streamed one again
clientBehaviour.closed: the focused id is missing from a newer list: show the full desktop and open the switcher
clientBehaviour.secureDesktop: show the full desktop while the desktop state is not the normal desktop
clientBehaviour.leave: send window-list-stop, then media-control follow:true if follow was on before entering
